goal: Independently re-QA the Phase 4B v2 playable-art integration after WP-042, proving the prior hazard-retry defect is fixed and all art, gameplay, runtime, scope, and readability requirements pass together.
forbidden_changes: final BK/Human Creative Owner play-feel approval
final art direction or production asset approval

verify.name: All implementation and prior QA evidence validates
verify.command: for wp in 040 041 042; do npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/active/WP-2026W28-${wp}.json; done && for run in 001 002 003; do npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260711-${run}.json; done && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/review.schema.json -d reviews/RV-20260711-001.json

verify.name: Approved art integration contract passes
verify.command: for asset in background_world_layer_v2 player_avatar_v2 goal_marker_v2 hazard_marker_v2 collectible_item_v2 safe_platform_tile_v2 ui_status_panel_v2; do test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png" && test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png.import" && rg -q "res://assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png" game/scenes/main.tscn; done && ! rg -n "res://assets/phase4b/direct_art/|_v1|SectionOneBackdrop|SectionTwoBackdrop" game/scenes/main.tscn

verify.name: Import, smoke, and headless runtime pass
verify.command: godot --headless --path game --import && bash -lc 'out=$(scripts/smoke_test.sh 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR:" <<< "$out"' && bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

human_decision_reason: A technical QA pass proves the playable slice is ready for direct play, but BK/Human Creative Owner still owns final play/feel judgment and any later production-art decision.
acceptance_criteria: Final QA modifies no game or implementation evidence file.
The prior RV-20260711-001 hazard-retry issue is reproduced as fixed by the full runtime suite.
Goal-before-item gating, collection, success, success reset, hazard failure, hazard reset stability, and timer expiry all pass in one automated live-scene run.
All seven approved v2 assets remain present, imported, referenced, visually separated, prototype-only, and production_approved=false.
The scene still uses one coherent BackgroundWorldLayer and no v1 art or split backdrop.
Godot import, smoke, and clean headless runtime pass.
Rendered left and right frames support the static gameplay hierarchy/readability judgment.
Final QA emits a pass/rework/blocked decision with actionable evidence and does not replace BK play/feel approval.
notes: This is the fresh QA pass after the QA-to-Implementation rework loop. It must independently execute the same runtime test that found the defect and treat any failure as rework.
